questions.stem: Why does higher temperature increase the rate of transpiration?

options.text: Heat causes the xylem vessels to widen
Heat causes the roots to absorb water more quickly
Higher temperature increases the number of stomata on the leaf
Higher temperature means more water evaporates from mesophyll cells and molecules diffuse faster

questions.explanation: At higher temperatures, water molecules have more kinetic energy, so more water evaporates from the surfaces of mesophyll cells. Water vapour molecules also diffuse out of the stomata faster.
